bounded_plan_and_risk.bounded_plan: Use a finite request plan containing EXECUTE, created under separately reviewed service-control authority. This avoids an unbounded shared bootplan silently hitting query_saplan256 or risk1000-task limits. query_saplan initially observes this exact request plan and must label that scope; a broader configured-plan read requires separately reviewed typed scope.
falsifiers: Claim result with missing/wrong/string-malformed attempt or absent claimed marker refuses.
Full-plan omission, stale digest, changed owner/attempt, unknown template, expired risk evidence or checker nonzero prevents all request effects.
Service startup/provider claim after previous epochs uses returned epoch>1; no agent impersonation or epoch fallback.
bounded_plan_and_risk.request_identity: Immutable bot numeric ID + update ID form stable logical request key; store full canonical content digest and reject same key/different content. Select request plan server-side with bounded valid identifiers.
risk_protocol: Service-control plan/task/finite grant covers provisioning exact read-only request plans and coordinator operations; none is implied by Telegram identity.

Independent review approves a finite risk assessment template for the two supported tools, including judgments, rationale, all UCAs, FMEA, source bindings, bounds and expiry rules. Runtime may instantiate request IDs/observed state/evidence only within that reviewed template; it may not invent favorable risk values.

After creating REQUEST_PLAN/EXECUTE, materialize a complete one-plan assessment from actual canonical task state and freshly observed bound bytes/clock. Call a release-pinned prebuilt validator with literal argv ['--preflight',PORTFOLIO,'EXECUTE']; require actual PREFLIGHT_PASS, freshness and complete-plan coherence. Missing template/validator/evidence or any HOLD stops before claim.

After real claim, refresh observed portfolio state/owner without laundering changed source or judgments. Call ['--active-check',PORTFOLIO,'EXECUTE',SERVICE_WORKER,ATTEMPT]; require actual ACTIVE_OBSERVATION_PASS before dispatch and next effect. Source/risk drift requires re-review, not timestamp editing.

No runtime use of tools/risk-priority-check wrapper: it compiles. Prebuild/pin validator and governing policy/package dependencies during development/release; execute in its reviewed canonical observation root with bounded timeout.
This adapter is a required implementation/review item, not an existing admitted runtime API. Pure development injects MissingRiskAdapter->Error until real tests prove it.

coordinator_exact_api.api: uos_swarm/session_authority.run(List(String)); function call, not a constructor. It prepends canonical DB internally.
coordinator_exact_api.claim_decode: Require JSON ok=true, expected operation_id/operation, positive integer epoch and future expires_boot_us. Persist returned epoch separately for runtime and each task. Never use literal epoch1.
invariants: Heartbeat does not renew any lease; renew runtime and current task resources independently before budget exhaustion.
Stable mutation op IDs survive ambiguous local response; retry same coordinator operation only through its documented durable idempotency and inspect receipt/fence.
Process-lifetime singleton lock and runtime lease precede polling; no network IO inside SQLite transaction. Expiry stops new effects and in-flight sends become uncertain.

delivery_and_recovery.authority: Keep EXECUTE executing through durable read-result/outbox preparation and bounded delivery attempt; complete only after a durable terminal outcome receipt. If dispatch is completed before sending, an explicitly separate admitted delivery task is required instead. Runtime lease alone must not silently replace Sa-plan effect authority.
delivery_and_recovery.cutover: Quiesce unsafe old poller and old Telegram bus execution before new service start; initial failure STOP and PRESERVE, never re-enable unsafe legacy.
durable_states: Commit immutable result and ordered chunks before send; store request plan/task/attempt/result digest and sender/destination identity.

Immediately before each send, require fresh active risk, current task and runtime/task coordinator fences and enough bounded budget. Commit SENDING before network dispatch. Budget must cover validator, fences, transport, durable receipt and cleanup; insufficient remaining task/resource window stops before send.
Crash from SENDING becomes UNCERTAIN; on restart never treat SENDING as PENDING, and never re-execute read after a committed immutable result.
If task has expired or completed before undelivered chunks, require canonical new/reclaimed reconciliation attempt and current risk before further send; preserve prior outcome evidence.

Initial release implements no operator resend API for UNCERTAIN. It stops/preserves for separately authorized reconciliation; incrementing attempt_count and same request_id do not make Telegram send idempotent.
If task completion fails after durable delivered/uncertain result, reconciliation may finish canonical bookkeeping without sending again.
delivery_and_recovery.retention: No automatic pruning initially. Future archival must retain replay tombstones and live/uncertain state; COMPLETE alone is not permission to discard an undelivered outbox.

development_boundary.acceptance: Independent candidate-bound source tests, adapter refusal controls and later immutable release review remain mandatory; syntax alone is not acceptance.
allowed_after_parent_task_authorization: Pure envelope/identity/command decoders and bounded result renderer.
Pure inbox/watermark/outbox state transitions and crash/concurrency fixtures in isolated test DBs.
Pure request authority state machine using explicit injected adapters whose missing capability returns Error.
Source changes for typed Service provider and protocol decoders in isolated AGY workspace, under separately declared finite scope.
blocked: Live BotAPI, production DB/task mutations, coordinator service registration/claims, actual poller/service cutover and release.
Any default PASS risk adapter, invented lease/attempt/provider, runtime compilation, global admission or model/provider identity substitution.

precedence: If adopted, this specification supersedes conflicting1053/1055/1059 API, risk, provider and delivery-retry proposals. Existing identity/FULL-sync/watermark/privacy/truthful-refusal/STOP-preserve constraints remain.
purpose: Concrete convergent correction for scoped development; no production authority or claimed implementation.
required_source_tests: Provider service registration/old-agent compatibility, malformed provider rejection, append/replay integrity and clock board actor binding.
Exact coordinator argv arity, response shape, returned epoch renewal/release and restart epoch>1.
Exact Sa-plan string-valued claim decoder and actual task readback; deterministic task create/claim/recovery against isolated DB.
Risk refusal matrix and no-production-effects default; no mocked PASS reported as live authority.

Identity forgery, bounded ordered-prefix watermark, FULL-sync settings, crash at every request/result/send/task-complete boundary, duplicate/chunk uncertain delivery and truthful legacy-route containment.

saplan_exact_api.api: cepaf_gleam/planning/sa_plan_bridge.run_sa_plan_cli(args), pinned canonical store and existing binary; do not run tools/sa-plan shell wrapper or pure create_task as real mutation.
saplan_exact_api.binding: dev.Binding("direct_read", REQUEST_PLAN, "EXECUTE", SERVICE_WORKER, ACTUAL_ATTEMPT, SESSION, ACTUAL_TASK_RESOURCE_EPOCH)
saplan_exact_api.canonical_recovery: Observe actual task first. Reconcile creation/claim/complete after ambiguous response before retry. Never replace actual attempt with a default; expired execution may be reclaimed only through canonical transition and fresh risk/preflight.
saplan_exact_api.claim_decode: Current emit serializes all these values as strings. Require claimed == string true and task exact; strict decimal parse attempt>0 and future lease_until_ns with no default. No state field exists in claim response. Then dev.read_task(binding) must observe executing, exact worker/attempt, dependencies ready and current sufficient deadline.
saplan_exact_api.dispatch: direct.dispatch_with_fencer(proposal, binding, direct.observe_fence_for, direct.execute_production_read_tool), with strict allowlist and args validator unchanged.
saplan_exact_api.resource: dev.task_resource(binding) is authoritative ordered-JSON digest. Do not reimplement concatenation; resource depends on plan/task, not attempt/epoch, so initial derivation may precede claim and final binding uses returned epoch.

service_identity.alternative: An externally provisioned agent-owned lease is valid only for an explicit finite supervised experiment with genuine owner delegation, expiry and heartbeat semantics. It is not suitable as the unattended service identity and is not the recommended production design.
minimum_scope: apps/uos_swarm/src/uos_swarm/session_sync.gleam: pure Provider decoder/renderer covering existing claude,codex,agy plus service; use it in registration validation while preserving historical wire encodings.
apps/uos_swarm/src/session_store_cli.gleam and session_sync_cli.gleam help/schema boundary plus focused provider/registration/replay/refusal tests.
Any board/clock_guard provider assumptions discovered by focused test must be explicitly included and reviewed; require board:<actual_service_session> references and real actor binding.
Update coordinator contract to distinguish service identity, supervising owner and finite action grant; provider membership grants no effects by itself.
service_identity.recommendation: Add explicit typed Service provider at coordinator validation boundary; wire label 'service' means a supervised non-model runtime. Do not relabel service as claude/codex/agy or borrow their live identity.
